entries.name: MCP specification
entries.best_use: Resolve normative behavior before adding implementation controls.
entries.important_boundary: That a particular server enforces the specification safely.

entries.name: MCP security best practices
entries.supported_claim: OAuth-related attacks, token handling, sessions, and access-control considerations.
entries.best_use: Create server and client security requirements.
entries.important_boundary: That non-auth prompt-injection paths are contained.

entries.name: MCP Inspector
entries.supported_claim: Connects to MCP servers and exposes tools, resources, and prompts for inspection.
entries.best_use: Manually inspect a development server’s exposed surface.
entries.important_boundary: Authorization correctness or resistance to malicious content.

entries.name: MCPJam Inspector
entries.supported_claim: Provides a UI for connecting to and testing MCP servers.
entries.best_use: Cross-check tool schemas and server behavior during development.

entries.name: mcp-scan
entries.supported_claim: Scans MCP configurations and server descriptions for risky patterns.
entries.best_use: Add a preflight inspection layer to a development workflow.
entries.important_boundary: Absence of runtime abuse or logic flaws.

entries.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
entries.supported_claim: Names prompt injection, excessive agency, sensitive disclosure, and related risks.
entries.best_use: Ensure the review includes threats beyond transport security.

entries.name: OAuth 2.1 draft
entries.best_use: Review authorization flows referenced by modern protocols.
entries.important_boundary: Application-level authorization to each MCP resource.

entries.name: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile
entries.supported_claim: Maps generative-AI risks to governance and measurement activities.
entries.best_use: Assign owners, evidence, and residual-risk decisions.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
